page.overview:
Who is Cadsuane Melaidhrin?

Cadsuane Melaidhrin is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah and the order's oldest living sister. She was one of Rand al'Thor's main advisors in the months before the Last Battle, and has since then been raised to the Amyrlin Seat. Her status among her fellow Aes Sedai is almost legendary; in fact, until recently, most believed her to be dead.

Cadsuane is undoubtedly among the strongest Aes Sedai living in the Third Age, and prior to the beginning of the series, hers was the highest strength level of any Aes Sedai for many hundreds of years.

It is stated in The Wheel of Time Companion that Cadsuane's angreal, while not a very powerful one, allowed her to reach the top male level of strength, which Rand al'Thor possessed.

There is a discrepancy about Cadsuane's exact level of strength in the One Power. The following excerpt from A Crown of Swords describes how her strength relates to Elayne's:
